data.title: Plan-system rollout — master
data.summary: Rollout complete 2026-05-26. The reckon SPA redesign, reckon server, reckon MCP transport, and reckon-sync/reckon-create/reckon-ship/reckon-edit/reckon-status skills all landed. plans-infra shipped. plans-agile-sprints decisions locked and sprint.html delivered. Migration plans handed off to their target repos (plans-migration-ambix → imas-ambix; plans-migration-efit → imas-efit) where they are tracked independently.

sections.body: The plan-system redesign (prototype delivered 2026-05-21) shipped in waves. dotfiles canonical landed at 7530860; ambix system pages landed at 3d3df82; tight-loop POST + identity fix + hide-shipped landed at 209b14c; live-fetch cutover landed at c1d9cf4 + c4a7ebe + 6137f4b; MOCK→STATE rename landed at 067aa94. This master plan owned the remaining waves and the open decisions that span them. All waves are now complete.

Five items originally tracked in S3: plans-infra (shipped), plans-agile-sprints (decisions locked + sprint.html delivered), plans-migration-ambix (moved to imas-ambix — tracks per-plan content migration there), plans-migration-efit (moved to imas-efit — tracks CSS + plan-test hook), and this master. Bootstrap-priority decision locked 2026-05-21 12:49 to serial order (Infra → Agile → Ambix → Efit). The two migration plans are cross-project concerns and are now tracked in their respective repos.

S3 lived inside the very system it built. Every decision captured as an inline-decision row on the relevant plan. Every handoff a followup with the §05 prompt template. The act of running S3 was itself the integration test — verified 2026-05-21 when typing 'rationale' on bootstrap-priority wrote through to docs/state/imas-ambix/plans-redesign-rollout.json (f-prio-1 resolved). The same pattern now applies to all plans system-wide.

S3 closed when (a) plan-infra had POSTing state.js + extended plan-style + new plan-init — DONE; (b) plans-agile-sprints had locked cadence + agent-rationale model — DONE; (c) plans-migration-ambix had at least one redesigned per-plan page approved and the pattern proven — moved to imas-ambix; (d) plans-migration-efit had CSS migrated + plan-test demoed — moved to imas-efit; (e) this master resolved its open decisions and locked the bootstrap order — DONE.

All core deliverables landed: (1) reckon SPA redesign — v7-shell.jsx three-column layout with filters, plans, content panels; Cmd-K palette; radial-fan dependency graph; sprint kanban with Lock button; critical-path graph tab; prompt generation. (2) reckon server — uv run reckon serve; brokers versioned writes; 412 conflict detection. (3) reckon MCP server — uv run reckon mcp; stdio transport; read_plan / patch_plan / lock_decision callable from Claude Code. (4) reckon-sync skill — idempotent onboarding and refresh for consumer projects. (5) plan-refactor-imas-ambix executed (commit a02d447 in imas-ambix) — legacy field strip surgery complete. (6) plan-refactor-imas-efit queued — scope documented in imas-efit/docs/curated/plan-refactor-imas-efit.html; execution pending. (7) Migration plans re-homed — plans-migration-ambix now in imas-ambix; plans-migration-efit now in imas-efit.

bootstrap-priority.choice: Infra → Agile → Ambix migration → Efit migration (serial, dependency order)

notes.body: Created via /plan-create with the user's instruction to bootstrap. We use this very plan-page to track the rollout — the decisions on this page WILL be tested as feedback-loop drivers.

Integration test verified end-to-end (f-prio-1 resolved). bootstrap-priority locked to serial order. plans-infra has 2/3 decisions locked (conflict-detection=version+412, rank-storage=sibling rank.json); shared-css-delivery is pending user weigh-in on CDN explanation. Implementation of plans-infra begins now with the two locked constraints honoured; CSS-delivery flow stays manual /plan-style refresh until the third decision lands.
Rollout complete. Marked shipped 2026-05-26. Migration plans re-homed to imas-ambix and imas-efit. blocks[] pruned to intra-repo refs only (plans-infra, plans-agile-sprints).

followups.title: Implement plans-infra: state.js POST + plan-style sync + plan-init skill
followups.body: Bootstrap-priority is locked to serial order; plans-infra is next. Two of three plans-infra decisions are locked: conflict-detection=version+412, rank-storage=sibling rank.json. shared-css-delivery is unresolved (CDN explanation pending); ship with manual /reckon-sync as the default behaviour.
followups.outcome: plans-infra shipped. state.js POST + 412; serve.py endpoint; reckon-sync and reckon-create skills. Full reckon repo redesign landed 2026-05-26.

Feedback loop verified end-to-end. User typed rationale='rationale' on bootstrap-priority (2026-05-21 12:25, by 'Simon McIntosh') — POST wrote through to docs/state/imas-ambix/plans-redesign-rollout.json. Subsequently user locked the choice to 'Infra → Agile → Ambix migration → Efit migration' (2026-05-21 12:49). Both writes preserved through the Path-A live-fetch cutover (commits c1d9cf4 + c4a7ebe + 6137f4b) and the MOCK→STATE rename (067aa94). Page UI confirmed via curl on https://simon-mcintosh.github.io/imas-ambix/state/imas-ambix/plans-redesign-rollout.json. The loop is closed.
followups.title: User test: lock a decision on this page; verify state JSON updates
followups.body: The tight-loop POST is wired (Persist.save in ui.jsx POSTs to reckon server). Visit the local URL, click bootstrap-priority chips + type rationale, hit Send. We expect docs/state/imas-ambix/plans-redesign-rollout.json to appear and contain the locked decision. This is the integration test for the whole feedback loop.

followups.title: Rollout closed — no followup required
followups.body: The plan-system redesign rollout is complete as of 2026-05-26. All deliverables listed in §5 have landed. Migration plans have been re-homed to their target repos. This plan is marked shipped. No further work queued here.
